name: Fan badge can be purchased
description: Verifies the digital fan badge is visible and its purchase action opens the concept checkout.
expected: The fan badge checkout opens and explains that no real payment is processed.

name: Children's care donation flow opens
description: Verifies visitors can select the $100 minimum donation and open the concept donation checkout without a charge.
steps: Scroll to the Children's Care donation section
expected: The donation modal opens showing the selected $100 amount and states that payment processing is not connected.

name: Accommodation remains actionable
description: Verifies accommodation information and its request action remain available.
expected: Three accommodation options are visible and the request button takes the visitor to the RSVP interest form.

name: Get tickets from management
description: Verifies the hero ticket action opens a management ticket request flow instead of an on-site ticket shop.
expected: A management ticket request modal opens with name, email, preferred show, and ticket request fields, plus a contact-management action.

name: RSVP interest works on mobile
description: Verifies the reserve-interest form remains usable on a phone-sized screen.
expected: A success message confirms the interest was recorded for the demo experience.
